title: verdict
body: After a weekend of research, one pie came out on top.

photos.alt: The hot honey margherita on the peel over the deck rail: honey shining on top, leopard-spotted crust, fallen leaves below.

title: recipe exploration
body: Dough in the cabin kitchen. Out to the oven on the deck. Back in for the next one. Repeat.

photos.alt: Wide shot of a log cabin kitchen: copper pans hung from the ceiling, a red tile counter, bowls of dough, two guys at work.
In the cabin kitchen, a guy in a tan cap holds a pepperoni pie on the peel and a speckled enamel plate.
Two guys at the red tile counter, one topping a pie, bowls of dough waiting.
A pie on the peel on its way out of the kitchen, a bowl of floured dough in front.
Close up of a pepperoni pie on the peel over a cutting board on the red tile counter.
A pie on the peel just out of the oven on the deck rail.
A pie on the peel over the deck rail: tomato, cubed cheese, pepperoni, a charred crust.
A guy on the deck holds out a pie on the peel, pine trees behind him.
A pie on a speckled enamel plate held out over the forest floor: tomato, cheese, a little green, charred spots.

title: research at deer camp
body: Research trip. We brought the Roccbox.

photos.alt: A buck pole: a timber arch with antlers on top and a banner reading Buck Pole, deer hanging from it, low sun behind.
A guy in a tan cap waits on the cabin deck by the Roccbox, peel in hand, a propane tank beside it.
Four guys around the Roccbox on the deck rail, pine trees all around.
